guarded_patterns.explanation: The ardenone-cluster app-of-apps must run in the centralized ardenone-manager ArgoCD instance, not self-manage from the workload cluster.

redirect.reason_template: Do not create applications-ardenone-cluster with an in-cluster destination. Define the root in k8s/ardenone-manager and let its child Applications target https://k3s-server-a.ardenone.com:6443.

guarded_patterns.example_content:
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata:
  name: applications-ardenone-cluster
spec:
  destination:
    server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
